authoredFrom: SOL-25 — the declarer half of the member-resolution fixture. Authored 2026-10-28 from the analyzer's measured symbols on this directory.
note: The two colliding member names must be DECLARED TWICE with distinct owners, and both declarations must be published with their OWNER — that is the fact the resolution pass reads. If either `shared` or `inherited` were published once, the rest of the fixture would prove nothing about collisions.
